mapper.select: /* UserTransferMapper.selectUserBasic */ SELECT U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , U.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS != '03' LIMIT 1

/* UserTransferMapper.selectFuturePartialLeaves */ SELECT L.LEAVE_ID AS leaveId , L.START_DATE AS startDate , L.START_TIME AS startTime , L.END_TIME AS endTime , L.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE L WHERE L.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND L.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND L.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND L.DEL_YN = 'N' AND L.USE_UNIT_TYPE != '00' AND NULLIF(TRIM(L.START_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL AND L.START_DATE >= #{moveDate} ORDER BY L.START_DATE ASC, L.START_TIME ASC

/* UserTransferMapper.selectDueReservations */ SELECT R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , R.RESERVATION_ID AS reservationId , R.USER_CD AS userCd , R.FROM_SITE_CD AS fromSiteCd , R.FROM_NODE_CD AS fromNodeCd , R.TO_SITE_CD AS toSiteCd , R.TO_NODE_CD AS toNodeCd , R.TO_DEFAULT_SCH_CD AS toDefaultSchCd , R.MOVE_DATE AS moveDate , R.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType , R.INSERT_NO AS insertNo FROM TB_USER_TRANSFER_RESERVATION R WHERE R.STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.MOVE_DATE <= #{today} ORDER BY R.CMPNY_CD ASC, R.MOVE_DATE ASC, R.RESERVATION_ID ASC

/* UserTransferMapper.selectActiveApproverReqIds */ SELECT R.REQ_ID FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.REQ_STATUS = '01' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND A.REQ_ID = R.REQ_ID AND A.APPROVER_USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('00', '01') )
mapper.sql: R.RESERVATION_ID AS reservationId , R.MOVE_DATE AS moveDate , S.SITE_NM AS toSiteNm , N.NODE_NM AS toNodeNm , M.SCH_NO AS defaultSchNm , R.MOVE_REASON AS moveReason

FROM TB_USER_TRANSFER_RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = R.TO_SITE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = R.TO_SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = R.TO_NODE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT M ON M.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND M.SITE_CD = R.TO_SITE_CD AND M.SCH_CD = R.TO_DEFAULT_SCH_CD AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
